concepts.gloss_en: The Torah novellae that a person innovates (in lm1:118 equated with the aspect of Mashiach, where his spirit hovers)
The Torah novellae that one reveals (in lm2:60, RaShbY/R. Akiva context, through which chasadim/Godliness are drawn down)

reason_for_human: The two groups share the noun 'Torah novellae' but differ in the operative verb: שֶׁמְּחַדֵּשׁ (innovates/creates) vs שֶׁמְּגַלִּין (reveals), and they sit in different lessons with different aspect-partners (משיח vs drawing down chasadim/אלקות). Per under-merge-beats-over-merge these distinct actions stay separate. Within the second concept the only difference is the definite article התורה/תורה — same word, correctly merged.
